sources.entry: Linger - Local-first visual reference library for saving images, source links, and notes, with keyword search and collections.

summary.name: Linger
summary.one_liner: Linger is a local-first image organizer for Mac that stores design references (images, screenshots, source links, and notes) in a private library on your computer.
use_cases: Collecting design inspiration in one flat library
Finding a saved image by a word from a note or by color
Keeping source links alongside saved references
Extracting HEX color palettes from images
Moving images from Eagle into a new library
Searching text in saved screenshots via OCR
summary.what_it_does: Linger lets you drop images, screenshots, and links into a single flat library without creating nested folders. It stores its own imported copies in a managed library folder you choose, leaving original Finder files untouched. It extracts color palettes from supported images in the background, and you can click a swatch to copy its HEX value or filter by similar colors. Search works across words from your notes, tags, colors, and OCR text in saved images, and results can show the original source link. An optional built-in stdio MCP server lets Claude or Codex read your references and notes on request; it is off by default.
notable: Flat library with search by note words, tags, or color instead of folders
Local color palette extraction with HEX copy
Built-in local MCP server for Claude or Codex, off by default
Keeps its own copy so Finder originals are untouched
caveats: Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later
No built-in cloud sync; each Mac has a separate library
Paid one-time licenses after a 7-day free trial; after trial only basic search and safe export remain
Eagle folders, tags, notes, and source links do not transfer automatically
